utilization_conditions.summary: 官方 ThingsBoard tb-node 单节点部署中，HTTP device telemetry path 会在认证结果返回前读取并绑定 chunked JSON body；在 -Xmx1024m / 2g 容器补测下，单个 512MiB timeseries-large-value telemetry 请求触发目标 JVM `OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` 并返回 HTTP 500。
limits_or_mitigations: Reverse proxy, servlet container, or Spring request limits that reject chunked/no-Content-Length bodies before controller binding mitigate this path.
A lower ThingsBoard HTTP transport max payload enforced independently of Content-Length would mitigate this path.
JSON string length/body complexity limits before @RequestBody String materialization would mitigate this path.
Authentication alone is insufficient if request body binding precedes token rejection for this endpoint shape.
not_affected_when: HTTP device transport is not exposed to low-trust clients.
Chunked request bodies without Content-Length are rejected or capped before Spring binds @RequestBody String.
Telemetry JSON body size/string length is bounded before JsonParser.parseString and JsonConverter processing.

commands: docker compose -p tb-dos-thingsboard-static-0001 run --rm -e INSTALL_TB=true -e LOAD_DEMO=false -e JAVA_OPTS='-Xms512m -Xmx1024m -Xss384k' tb-node
config_changes: Mapped HTTP port 8080 to localhost:18080 for isolation.
Set TB_SERVICE_TYPE=monolith and TB_QUEUE_TYPE=in-memory, matching image defaults used for single-node deployment.
Strict retest harness capped target JVM with -Xms512m -Xmx1024m and container memory with mem_limit=2g.
Removed non-HTTP host port mappings after an unrelated MQTT port collision; validated entry used HTTP only.

trigger.request_shape: HTTP/1.1 POST /api/v1/{deviceToken}/telemetry with Transfer-Encoding: chunked, Content-Type: application/json, no Content-Length, and a JSON object shaped as {"ts":1,"values":{"k":"<large string>"}}.
trigger.loop_variable: body byte volume in one JSON string value
trigger.bandwidth_notes: Single external HTTP client, sequential chunked requests. The 512MiB telemetry body returned HTTP 500 with an OutOfMemoryError message under -Xmx1024m.
